Bid Summary.value: Dallas ISD is soliciting proposals for student and staff computing devices. The RFP includes M/WBE prime self-performance requirements up to 50% of project goals. Contract formation requires Board of Trustees approval and formal purchase orders before any delivery. Vendors must comply with criminal background checks and identification badge requirements. Addendum 1 clarifies Form 1295 submission with responses and allows electronic PDF submissions.
